title: Meridian Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Purpose-built for long-distance touring, the Apex Meridian Black is built for mile-crushing grand tours and cross-country adventures to minimize neck fatigue on cross-country treks. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1294g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~83 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Touring helmet with sun visor and Bluetooth-ready design.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for touring with a semi-sport fit; generally runs true to size but may feel snug on the cheeks due to extended chin bar geometry. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Apex Meridian Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Apex Meridian Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Apex Meridian Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Apex's Touring lineup, the Meridian Black brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Apex Meridian Black represents Apex's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~83 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Touring helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Apex Meridian Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
